title: GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times Revealed, Xbox New Zealand Trick
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 worldwide unlock times revealed, and Xbox owners can seemingly still use the old New Zealand trick to play early.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times and Release Details

As the excitement surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to build, new details have emerged regarding when players can actually get their hands on the game. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to arrive on 19th November for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

However, depending on where you may be located in the world, the exact moment you get to play varies. Because the release is tied to regional timing, players across different time zones will experience staggered access to the game when it launches in November.

## The Classic New Zealand Trick for Xbox Owners

An interesting detail highlighted in the report is that Xbox owners can seemingly still use the old New Zealand trick to play early. The practice of switching console regions to tap into earlier time zones has long been a staple for dedicated console players looking to bypass midnight launches in their local regions.

While players will need to wait for official confirmation on how digital storefronts will handle the exact rollout, the prospect of utilizing this familiar workaround has already generated plenty of discussion within the community.

## Editor's Take

The countdown to 19th November is officially on. While staggered unlock times are standard industry practice, the hint that the classic New Zealand region trick might still work on Xbox is a welcome bonus for Microsoft console owners eager to dive in as early as possible.
